Can I reroute the package to a different address?

You cannot reroute it through us after the order is placed, but once you have the tracking number you can try through the carrier instead. If it shipped with UPS, you can request an address change with a free UPS My Choice account, and if it shipped with FedEx, you can try FedEx Delivery Manager, though FedEx SmartPost cannot be rerouted.

If you want me to check which carrier your order used, send either your email address and order ID, your email address and shipping ZIP code, or the full name on the shipping label and shipping ZIP code.
